render_reference.note: Scale the entire cell uniformly and register foot anchor to player bottom; do not force full cell to 36x56. Collisions remain game-defined.

transitions.parry_failure: no recoil: return to active fall pose after 0.16s
transitions.jump_rise: hold last pose until apex then choose matching fall aim
transitions.death: play once then hold final frame
transitions.hurt: resume current locomotion after 0.125 seconds; use game invincibility blink without baked transparency
transitions.parry_attempt: four frames at 0.04s each; success interrupts immediately
transitions.parry_success_launch: play 0.15s curled launch, then jump rise while vy>0, fall when vy<=0; world motion comes from physics

limitations: AI generated run cycles approximate half-cycle symmetry; anatomical near/far leg crossing is not mechanically guaranteed.
Muzzle locations are silhouette-derived estimates, not manually calibrated gun bore measurements.
Per-frame head and sole alignment reduces drift but limb proportions and pencil strokes retain generated variation.
revision_changes: Only crouch idle, crouch move and collapse/death rows replaced.
Darker black graphite strokes and longer articulated limbs relative to same head scale.
32 replacement frames; all other atlas cells and effect image preserved.
